en.headline: About your blood sugar
body: Diabetes means your blood has too much sugar in it.
A walk after meals helps your body use sugar.
Your doctor checks your sugar with a blood test.
en.passage: Diabetes is a condition where there is too much sugar (glucose) in the blood.

ms.headline: Tentang gula dalam darah anda
body: Kencing manis bermakna darah anda ada terlalu banyak gula.
Berjalan selepas makan membantu badan anda guna gula.
Doktor anda periksa gula anda dengan ujian darah.
ms.passage: Diabetes is a condition where there is too much sugar (glucose) in the blood.

zh.headline: 关于您的血糖
body: 糖尿病就是您血里的糖太多。
饭后散步能帮身体用掉糖。
医生会用验血来查您的血糖。
zh.passage: Diabetes is a condition where there is too much sugar (glucose) in the blood.
